comment: File Explorer namespaces and desktop icons (customer request 1 of 04.10.2026). Generated by
tools/make_shell_rules.py; edit the tables in that tool, not this file.

rules.title: Show "Recycle Bin" in "This PC"
rules.summary: "Recycle Bin" appears in "This PC" next to the drives, for all users.
rules.effect: Adds a namespace entry; nothing is moved. Off by default: "This PC" shows only the drives, as in Windows 11.
rules.risk: Reported by third parties for Windows 10 and 11; check on 25H2 in a virtual machine.
rules.versions: Windows 10 and 11, all editions. Written to both the 64-bit and the 32-bit (WOW6432Node) branches so that dialogs of 32-bit programs match File Explorer.
rules.rollback: Delete the {645FF040-5081-101B-9F08-00AA002F954E} key in both NameSpace branches (the automatic return to defaults does not delete keys).

rules.title: Show "Control Panel" in "This PC"

rules.title: Show "Libraries" in the File Explorer navigation pane
rules.summary: "Libraries" is shown in the left pane of File Explorer and of file dialogs.
rules.effect: Written for each user at the first sign-in (Active Setup); the user can change it again. Accounts that already exist are not changed, and "Apply" on this PC does not run first sign-in rules.
rules.versions: Windows 10 and 11, all editions. The machine registration of the item belongs to TrustedInstaller, so the value System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree is set per user, also for 32-bit file dialogs (WOW6432Node). Microsoft documents the value for cloud storage providers; for this item it is reported by third parties.
rules.rollback: Delete the value System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree under HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{031E4825-7B94-4dc3-B131-E946B44C8DD5} and its WOW6432Node twin of the user.

rules.title: Hide "Network" in the File Explorer navigation pane

rules.effect: Written for each user at the first sign-in (Active Setup); the user can change it again. Accounts that already exist are not changed, and "Apply" on this PC does not run first sign-in rules.
rules.risk: Shared folders of other computers can no longer be browsed from the navigation pane of File Explorer and of file dialogs; typing \\computer\share in the address bar still works. Workgroups that share folders need the item.
rules.versions: Windows 10 and 11, all editions. The machine registration of the item belongs to TrustedInstaller, so the value System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree is set per user, also for 32-bit file dialogs (WOW6432Node). Microsoft documents the value for cloud storage providers; for this item it is reported by third parties.

rules.title: Show all folders in the File Explorer navigation pane
rules.summary: The left pane also shows Desktop, the user folder, Control Panel and Recycle Bin, as with "Show all folders".
rules.effect: For accounts created after installation; the user can change it again (right-click the navigation pane).
rules.versions: Windows 10 and 11, all editions. The option is documented; the value name is reported by third parties.
rules.rollback: Right-click the navigation pane and clear "Show all folders".

rules.title: Show USB drives only under "This PC" in the navigation pane
rules.summary: Removable drives no longer appear a second time as separate items at the top of the left pane.
rules.effect: Deletes the "Removable Drives" delegate folder of the desktop namespace in both branches; the drives stay under "This PC".
rules.risk: Reported by third parties; a feature update of Windows may create the key again. The automatic return to defaults cannot restore a deleted key.
rules.versions: Windows 10 and 11, all editions.
rules.verify: reg query "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Desktop\NameSpace\DelegateFolders\{F5FB2C77-0E2F-4A16-A381-3E560C68BC83}" and the same path under HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft: after the rule both answer that the key cannot be found (before it they show the default value "Removable Drives"); C:\ProgramData\Unattend\Logs\Setup-System.log has two OK lines "removed ...".
rules.rollback: Create the key again in both branches with the default value "Removable Drives".

rules.title: No cloud files and activity in File Explorer "Home"
rules.summary: File Explorer does not request the metadata of cloud files and shows no files based on the account and cloud activity in "Home" (Recent, Recommended, Shared).
rules.effect: Local recent files stay. Value 1 of the policy FileExplorer/DisableGraphRecentItems, which Microsoft calls "Turn off account-based insights, recent, favorite, and recommended files in File Explorer" (the ADMX of Windows names it "Show files based on your account and cloud provider activity").
rules.versions: Windows 11 22H2 and later. Explorer.admx sets no edition limit; the Policy CSP lists Pro, Enterprise and Education, as it covers delivery through MDM. Check the effect on Home in a virtual machine.
rules.rollback: Delete the DisableGraphRecentItems value.

rules.title: Show the "This PC" icon on the desktop
rules.summary: New accounts get the "This PC" icon on the desktop.
rules.effect: For accounts created after installation; the user can change it in Settings, Personalization, Themes, Desktop icon settings. Accounts that already exist are not changed.
rules.versions: Windows 10 and 11, all editions. Written as the Desktop icon settings dialog writes it (NewStartPanel and ClassicStartMenu).
rules.rollback: Delete the value {20D04FE0-3AEA-1069-A2D8-08002B30309D} in HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel and ClassicStartMenu of the user.

rules.rollback: Delete the value {031E4825-7B94-4dc3-B131-E946B44C8DD5} in HideDesktopIcons\NewStartPanel and ClassicStartMenu of the user.
